item.title: IEA flags concentration of clean energy supply chains as emerging challenge
item.description: The concentration of a small number of countries in clean energy supply chains is an emerging challenge for Southeast Asian countries, International Energy Agency Executive Director Fatih Birol said on Tuesday, amid fast-rising power demand in the region.
item.dc:creator: Siyi Liu, Florence Tan
item.content:encoded: The concentration of a small number of countries in clean energy supply chains is an emerging challenge for Southeast Asian countries, International Energy Agency Executive Director Fatih Birol said on Tuesday, amid fast-rising power demand in the region. "The age of electricity is coming. We will still use oil, still use natural gas including LNG, but electricity demand is growing very strongly," Birol told delegates at the Singapore International Energy Week conference. Birol did not identify the countries dominating clean energy supplies, but China is by far the largest global supplier of renewable energy equipment, from solar panels to wind turbines, electric vehicles and batteries. Electricity demand in ASEAN countries is rising at twice the pace of overall energy consumption, driven by industrial electrification, air-conditioning needs, electric vehicles and data centres, he said. Southeast Asian nations have emerged as[USN:L1N3A320I TEXT:" key drivers of China's clean-energy export boom"], splashing out over $20 billion on Chinese-made clean-tech products so far in 2026, according to energy think tank Ember. Birol also warned that geopolitical tensions have become an increasingly dominant force in global energy markets. "In my professional life, I have never, never ever seen the dark and long shadow of geopolitics dominating the energy sector in such a way," he said. "I can only imagine that the role of geopolitics will be much more pronounced, and this means energy security is going to become even more important than it is today." Birol said the Middle East war has triggered fundamental changes in global energy consumption patterns, spurring growth in solar, coal and nuclear power as well as electric vehicle adoption. "I see in the last eight months very strong growth of electric car sales," he said, adding that global electric vehicle sales outside China had risen 60% above previous trends over the period because of the conflict. Consumption of alternative energy sources has increased as diesel prices have jumped about 200% and LNG prices have risen 250% from pre-war levels, according to Birol. He [USN:L2N46C04R TEXT:"said on Monday"] at the same conference that he does not expect energy markets in 2027 to return to where they were before the US-Israeli war on Iran began.

item.title: EU seeks to widen market access to counter trade restrictions, Germany's Merz says
item.description: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz said on Tuesday that the European Union is seeking to collaborate more deeply on open market access to counter restrictions on global trade, including with Southeast Asia and members of the CPTPP trade pact.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz said on Tuesday that the European Union is seeking to collaborate more deeply on open market access to counter restrictions on global trade, including with Southeast Asia and members of the CPTPP trade pact. The world is changing and the EU, with 450 million consumers, has become more active in seeking and building on partnerships to expand free trade with open competition, reliability and a rules-based order, Merz said during a visit to Singapore. "This is a deliberate counterpoint to what we are currently seeing ... we want to do things differently and we want to show that there is a better way," Merz told a press conference The Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership, or CPTPP, is a trade agreement comprising 12 countries, including Japan, Britain, Canada, Mexico, Australia, Singapore and Malaysia Singapore Prime Minister Lawrence Wong said his country, when it becomes chair of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations bloc in 2027, will push to make progress on an ASEAN-EU free trade deal The EU has bilateral FTAs with several ASEAN countries and negotiations are ongoing with other ASEAN members "We recognise that it will be challenging. It's complex, but we can also have some confidence in moving forward," Wong said about the ASEAN-EU agreement Merz said he has called on the EU to better coordinate its existing bilateral trade frameworks with partners like Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia and India to "open up better opportunities for us and our businesses in the region" He also said the EU would be willing to get involved in an ASEAN initiative to integrate its power grids and cooperate more on defence and security

item.title: HSBC shares tumble 6% after third-quarter revenue disappoints, wealth growth slows
item.description: HSBC's shares slid 6% on Tuesday after revenue undershot estimates and growth at its wealth business slowed, highlighting the challenge big banks face to sustain recent record profits.
item.dc:creator: Selena Li, Lawrence White
item.content:encoded: HSBC's shares slid 6% (HSBA.L) on Tuesday after revenue undershot estimates and growth at its wealth business slowed, highlighting the challenge big banks face to sustain recent record profits. Europe's largest bank reported a 32% surge in pretax profit to $9.6 billion for the July-September quarter, in line with estimates. But investors and analysts focused on the lack of upgrades to the bank's performance guidance and underwhelming third-quarter revenue of $18.6 billion against forecasts for $19 billion. The drop in the bank's shares underscores how recent strong results from European lenders have increased investor expectations for performance, even as the impact of the Iran war on inflation and interest rates has created a tough environment for banks. The shares remain up 9% for the year to date. HSBC also launched a share buyback of up to $1 billion, the same amount as the previous quarter and a move that had boosted shares in previous reporting periods but is now largely expected by investors. "There is sometimes a market expectation that we upgrade guidance or targets," CFO Pam Kaur told reporters on a conference call when asked about the share drop. Analysts noted that the bank's net interest income slightly missed expectations, while fee income from its key wealth growth pillar was steady but unspectacular. Escalating deposit competition in Hong Kong and the UK, HSBC's two core markets, are expected to push up interest expenses, they said. Time deposits in the bank's Hong Kong portfolio rose two percentage points quarter-on-quarter to 38%, but Jefferies analysts noted that the shift to chase higher deposits by offering higher interest rates is expected to erode margins. Revenue for HSBC's wealth division was flat at $2.7 billion. That compared with 15% and 23% year-on-year revenue growth in the first two quarters. The performance of HSBC's wealth business is under particular scrutiny because the British bank, like its peers, is focusing growth on fee-generating businesses such as wealth management as lending comes under pressure from falling interest rates. Analysts warned that Asia-focused banks are bracing for a [USN:L3N46C09B TEXT:"slowdown in wealth momentum"] following robust gains driven by Chinese capital inflows. Kaur said on the call that [USN:L4N45U04N TEXT:"China's tightening of wealth flows"] has prompted clients to shift from other banks in Hong Kong to HSBC. "We picked up more business." BRITAIN'S BANKS POISED FOR TAX HIKES HSBC benefited from the absence of legal provisions booked in the same quarter a year earlier. It also said expected credit losses tumbled 17% to $800 million, thanks to a reduction in charges linked to Hong Kong's real estate sector as well as its UK and Mexican wealth businesses. British banks' strong recent results have prompted calls from trade unions and activist groups for tax hikes on the sector in finance minister John Healey's first budget, due on Wednesday. Bank bosses have lobbied hard to avoid such an increase in sector levies, arguing it would curb lending and make Britain less competitive. HSBC announced an interim dividend of $0.1 per share, the same as the previous quarter.

item.title: Alibaba wins injunction against Pentagon contract restrictions tied to China blacklist
item.description: A US federal judge on Monday granted Alibaba Group Holding's request for a preliminary injunction, ordering the US government not to deny Pentagon contracts to companies because they, their parent companies or subsidiaries do business with firms that engage in lobbying activities for the e-commerce giant.
item.dc:creator: Eduardo Baptista, Laurie Chen
item.content:encoded: A US federal judge on Monday granted Alibaba Group Holding's (9988.HK) request for a preliminary injunction, ordering the US government not to deny Pentagon contracts to companies because they, their parent companies or subsidiaries do business with firms that engage in lobbying activities for the e-commerce giant. Alibaba [USN:L1N42V0RB TEXT:"sued"] the US government in June after the Pentagon added it to a [USN:FWN42G12Z TEXT:"list of companies"] allegedly aiding China's military, alongside internet search provider Baidu, EV maker BYD and other major Chinese manufacturing and technology firms. Monday's ruling means Alibaba will be able to retain US lobbyists who also represent Pentagon contractors, removing a potential obstacle to the company's efforts to challenge its designation as a Chinese military company. Alibaba fired dozens of its Washington lobbyists after the Pentagon action in June, according to a source with direct knowledge of the matter who was not authorised to speak to the media. The designation does not impose formal sanctions, but restricts Pentagon contracts with listed companies and, from 2027, purchases of their products or services through third parties. Other listed Chinese tech firms were also concerned about the designation's impact on international lobbying activities as well as the indirect procurement ban, which would completely remove Chinese products from US defence contractors' supply chains, the source added. Alibaba has denied any military ties, saying its products and services are built for retail, logistics, and enterprise technology rather than defence or intelligence. "The determinations have no basis in fact or law," Alibaba said in its lawsuit in June, seeking its removal from the list. Monday's injunction does not remove Alibaba from the Pentagon list, which the company is continuing to challenge in court. Alibaba did not immediately respond to a request for comment on the injunction. COMPANIES TAKE LEGAL ACTION Alibaba is one of several Chinese firms taking legal action to challenge their placement on the Pentagon's list. Last month, two subsidiaries of the world's largest electric vehicle maker BYD (002594.SZ) sued the US Department of Defence over a federal law banning any Pentagon contractors from hiring lobbyists that also work with blacklisted firms, arguing that it breached BYD's First Amendment rights. In August, DJI, the world's largest drone maker, [USN:L6N44B0VR TEXT:"appealed"] its inclusion on the blacklist with the court finding merit in its argument that unclassified records did not support the conclusion that the company contributed to the Chinese defence industrial base. The appeals court ordered the lower court to reconsider its decision to reject DJI's bid to be removed from the Pentagon list and the case is ongoing. The same month, biotech firm WuXi AppTec Co (603259.SS) also won a preliminary [USN:L1N4440V2 TEXT:"injunction"] from a US federal court, which blocked its inclusion on the list. WuXi said the Pentagon designation was politically motivated.

item.title: 英ＨＳＢＣ、傘下ファンド事業統合へ 恒生銀行の事業吸収＝関係筋
item.description:
Summer Zhen Selena Li
［香港 ２６日 ロイター］ - 英金融大手ＨＳＢＣホールディングスが、傘下...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
英ＨＳＢＣ、傘下ファンド事業統合へ　恒生銀行の事業吸収＝関係筋 12:41 配信

香港の金融街にあるHSBC本社ビルで2020年8月4日撮影　 REUTERS/Tyrone Siu（ロイター） Summer Zhen　Selena Li

［香港　２６日　ロイター］ - 英金融大手ＨＳＢＣホールディングスが、傘下の恒生銀行（ハンセン銀行）の資産運用部門を自社のファンド事業に統合する。事情に詳しい関係者２人が２６日明らかにした。

関係者によると、ＨＳＢＣアセット・マネジメント（運用資産約８７６０億ドル）が、恒生投資管理（ハンセン・インベストメント・マネジメント）（同約５００億ドル）を吸収する計画。

ＨＳＢＣはロイターへの電子メール声明で、香港市場で競争力を高めるため、資産運用事業の規模や人材、成長戦略の強化を目指していると述べたが、資産運用部門の統合計画についてはコメントを控えた。

「将来の成長機会を引き出すため、各チーム間の連携に注力している」とした上で、恒生銀行については独立した銀行免許を持つ銀行として維持すると改めて説明した。

恒生銀行はロイターのコメント要請に応じていない。

ＨＳＢＣは２０２５年１０月、恒生銀行の買収・非公開化に向けた手続きを開始。買収総額は１３６億ドルで、取引は２６年１月に完了した。

今回の統合が実現すれば、両行のブランドを独立して維持するとの従来方針の下で進められてきた経営体制において、初の事業部門レベルの統合となる。

恒生銀行は、香港の代表的株価指数であるハンセン指数に連動する上場投資信託（ＥＴＦ）「トラッカー・ファンド・オブ・ホンコン」を運営している。同ファンドは香港最大のＥＴＦで、香港の公的年金制度である強制積立基金（ＭＰＦ）における主要投資商品にもなっている。

ロイター 関連リンク 焦点：債務膨張の先進国に金融危機の芽、最も懸念される米・伊・英 アングル：英新財務相、実務手腕に一定評価も支出拡大・増税不安消えず アングル：英国経済、ＥＵ離脱から10年の軌跡 アングル：ブレグジット10年、英ＥＵの溝なお深く　極右台頭も重し 焦点：ＥＵ離脱から10年、苦闘続く英輸出企業　非離脱シナリオより低成長の予測 10/27(火) 12:41 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: アンソロピックＩＰＯ、みずほ・ＭＵＦＧも幹事証券 日本でも販売へ
item.description:
Miho Uranaka
[東京 ２７日 ロイター] - 米ＡＩ（人工知能）開発のアンソロピックは２６日、米国での新規...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アンソロピックＩＰＯ、みずほ・ＭＵＦＧも幹事証券　日本でも販売へ 12:37 配信

ニューヨーク証券取引所で、アンソロピックの新規株式公開に関するニュースが表示されている　2026年10月26日撮影　REUTERS/Jeenah Moon（ロイター） Miho Uranaka

[東京 ２７日 ロイター] - 米ＡＩ（人工知能）開発のアンソロピックは２６日、米国での新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）に向けた申請書類（Ｓ－１）を公開した。幹事証券団には、みずほフィナンシャルグループと三菱ＵＦＪフィナンシャル・グループ（ＭＵＦＧ）傘下の証券会社が並んだ。アンソロピックは、日本での資金調達を実施する方向だ。

みずほは英半導体設計大手アームや宇宙開発企業スペースＸ 、ＰａｙＰａｙの米国上場でも幹事を務めた実績がある。現在ＩＰＯの準備を進めているＳＢエナジーでは、みずほに加えてＭＵＦＧも幹事に名を連ねている。

アンソロピックは、日本を含む米国外でも公募を行う方針で、今後、日本での公募に向けて関東財務局に届出書を提出する見通し。主幹事はゴールドマン・サックスとモルガン・スタンレーが務める。

ロイターは、アンソロピックが最近の投資家向けイベントで財務情報の一部を開示した後、既存株主や出資を検討する投資家の一部が同社の評価額を約１兆５０００億ドルと見積もっていると報じていた。

Ｓ－１書類によると、巨額の赤字と急速な売上高の伸びが明らかになった。アンソロピックの２０２６年上期の純損失は８０７億ドルと大幅に拡大した。主に、転換社債の公正価値が上昇したことが響いた。同期の売上高は約１６３億ドルだった。６月３０日までの３カ月間の売上高は、前年同期比１３６８％増と急増した。開発に多額の費用がかかる中でも、世界経済を変革し得るＡＩシステムの構築を目指す姿勢を示した。

ロイター 関連リンク 焦点：ＮＡＳＡローマン宇宙望遠鏡打ち上げへ、ダークエネルギーやダークマターの解明期待 アングル：米金融大手、第2四半期は軒並み好決算　投資銀・取引部門がけん引 アングル：スペースＸ株が公開価格割れ、投資家の信頼守れるか　他案件に影響も アングル：米国で新たに44万人の「ＡＩ長者」、高級品の支出と嗜好にも変化 アングル：円債に海外マネー、日本の運用各社が戦略強化　みずほ系は欧州から運用受託へ 10/27(火) 12:37 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: Jackson Chourio, Brewers blitz Rays in Game 3, close in on Series sweep
item.description: ST. PETERSBURG, Fla. -- The Milwaukee Brewers benefited from an offensive barrage with two outs in the fifth inning to move within one win of the first World Series title in franchise history.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: ST. PETERSBURG, Fla. -- The Milwaukee Brewers benefited from an offensive barrage with two outs in the fifth inning to move within one win of the first World Series title in franchise history. Jackson Chourio highlighted his four-hit performance with an RBI double to cap an eight-run fifth inning, fueling Milwaukee to a 10-1 romp over the Tampa Bay Rays on Monday as the Brewers took a 3-1 lead in the Fall Classic. Chourio is 8-for-14 with four runs in the first three contests of the World Series. The Brewers, who are 10-1 in the postseason, will look to capture their first World Series title in Game 4 on Tuesday in St. Petersburg. Milwaukee recorded 16 hits to provide more than enough offense for Robert Gasser (1-0), who allowed one hit -- Yandy Diaz's single to lead off the first -- over six scoreless innings. He walked one and struck out three to become the first left-hander to face the minimum 18 batters through six innings of a World Series game since Hall of Famer Sandy Koufax accomplished the feat for the Los Angeles Dodgers in 1965. Gasser has yielded one run on seven hits in 15 innings over three outings in the postseason. "It was a great team win, but we've got work to do," Gasser told Fox Sports. "There's still one more game to go." The Brewers broke open the game in the fifth after a replay review overturned a call at second base in which a hustling Christian Yelich initially was called out to end the inning. "The whole game was changed when Yeli was safe at second, that's a hustle play," Milwaukee manager Pat Murphy said. "When your leader makes that play, that says it all." Instead, Milwaukee had the bases loaded, and the Brewers turned a 2-0 game into a 10-0 laugher when each of the next six batters reached base. Cam Booser relieved Freddy Peralta (2-1) and promptly permitted a sharp single by Brice Turang that caromed off the glove of shortstop Taylor Walls and into shallow center field, allowing Chourio and Yelich to score. Garrett Mitchell added an RBI single to left field, Cooper Pratt bounced a two-run double over the third base bag, and Sal Frelick delivered an RBI double to extend the Brewers' lead to 8-0. That chased Booser, but David Hamilton greeted Cole Sulser with an RBI single and Chourio added a run-scoring double to push Milwaukee's advantage to 10-0. "Afterward, it's just a credit to the guys just passing the baton to each other," Yelich said. "We were able to have good AB after good AB, and we were able to lengthen it out there." Tampa Bay manager Kevin Cash naturally sang a different tune. "It's definitely deflating, how can it not be?" Cash said of the inning. Chourio singled off Peralta with one out in the third inning, advanced to second on a walk by Jake Bauers and opened the scoring on Yelich's single to left field. Milwaukee doubled the advantage on the next pitch when William Contreras singled to right field. Victor Mesa Jr. briefly bobbled the ball, allowing Bauers to score from second base. Peralta permitted five runs on seven hits in 4 2/3 innings against the team with which he spent the first eight seasons of his major league career. Diaz had an RBI double in the ninth inning off Brewers veteran Brandon Woodruff, who hadn't pitched since July 4 due to a shoulder injury. --Field Level Media

item.title: 日英伊戦闘機開発、エアバスが参加模索か ＢＡＥと協議予定と英紙
item.description: ［２５日 ロイター］ - 欧州航空機大手エアバスが、日英伊官民の次世代戦闘機共同開発への参画を模索しているもようだ。...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
日英伊戦闘機開発、エアバスが参加模索か　ＢＡＥと協議予定と英紙 12:25 配信

2026年2月6日、フランスのマルセイユ近郊、マリニャーヌにあるエアバス・ヘリコプターズの工場で、エアバスのロゴが見られる。 REUTERS/Manon Cruz（ロイター） ［２５日　ロイター］ - 欧州航空機大手エアバスが、日英伊官民の次世代戦闘機共同開発への参画を模索しているもようだ。英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（ＦＴ）は２５日、エアバスの幹部が参画に向けて英防衛大手ＢＡＥシステムズと協議する見通しだと報じた。

ＧＣＡＰは２０３５年までの開発を目指しており、企業ではＢＡＥ、三菱重工業、イタリアのレオナルドが参画している。

エアバスの広報担当者はロイターに対し「エアバスは、ドイツ、スペインおよび欧州の産業界が開発、生産、運用で実質的かつ対等な参加を認められることを条件に、協力することに原則として前向きだ」とコメントした。

ＢＡＥはコメント要請に応じなかった。

ＦＴによると、エアバスとＢＡＥは自律型の「協調戦闘機」などでの協力についても話し合う見通しだ。また、戦闘機やドローン（無人機）、地上レーダーなどのセンサーの間でデータ交換を可能にするデジタル基盤「コンバットクラウド」も協業分野になり得るとしている。

バーナム英首相は今月、英国がドイツのＧＣＡＰ参加に前向きな見解を示していた。カナダは７月にＧＣＡＰへのオブザーバー参加を表明しており、サウジアラビアも参加に関心を示していると伝えられてきた。

item.title: Judge extends block on Trump plans to renovate Washington golf course
item.description: A US judge extended on Monday a court order blocking President Donald Trump's plans to renovate a historic Washington golf course where she had deemed a removal of trees "inexcusable".
item.dc:creator: Kanishka Singh
item.content:encoded: A US judge extended on Monday a court order blocking President Donald Trump's plans to renovate a [USN:L6N46503C TEXT:"historic Washington golf course"] where [USN:L1N45Y0L4 TEXT:"she had deemed"] a removal of trees "inexcusable". The renovation, at the center of a lawsuit over environmental and historic preservation concerns, is one of the projects Trump is pursuing to reshape landmarks in the US capital. "The court still does not speak for the trees," US District Judge Ana Reyes said in her order filed in the district court for the District of Columbia, adding, "It speaks only for the rule of law." Her order barred the government from "removing or damaging additional trees" on the course. It also ordered the government to provide 10 business days of written advance notice before it makes any "irreparable modification" at the park, pending the suit outcome. Trump said in an online post late on Monday the government would appeal the decision and that his administration would close "the East Potomac Golf Course Site as scheduled on November 15th in order to renovate and rebuild." Two weeks earlier, Reyes faulted the conduct of Justice Department lawyers in the lawsuit seeking to halt the Trump administration's takeover of the historic golf course. It was "inexcusable" that hundreds of trees were removed from the course during the prior weekend, she added. Last week Trump said his administration [USN:L6N46503C TEXT:"would begin renovation"] work immediately, despite the judge's order that work could not proceed without prior notice to the court. Trump had also attacked the judge by calling her a "lunatic." The DC Preservation League sued in February to halt the takeover, on the grounds that it would violate environmental laws and "irreparably destroy a priceless piece of American history." Reyes said the government had asked her to disregard Trump's statements about the renovation plans. "Rarely, if ever, has the United States Department of Justice urged a federal court not to believe the sitting president," Reyes said. "This started as a case about golf ... But it has become much more," she added. "It now forces the court to reconcile assertions by President Donald J. Trump with the sworn testimony of multiple government employees and the argument of senior DOJ attorneys."

item.description:
Fumiya Mizuno
[東京 ２７日 ロイター] - 前場の東京株式市場で日経平均は反発し、前営業日比１．９２％...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
午前の日経平均は反発、ＡＩ・半導体株を物色　中盤から伸び悩む 12:01 配信

写真は2024年12月、都内の東京証券取引所で撮影。 REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon（ロイター） Fumiya Mizuno

[東京 ２７日 ロイター] - 前場の東京株式市場で日経平均は反発し、前営業日比１．９２％（１１９１円６４銭）高の６万３３８１円２９銭となった。米ハイテク株上昇の流れを受けて、ＡＩ（人工知能）・半導体関連株が幅広く物色されて戻り歩調を鮮明にし、前営業日比で一時２．４％（１４９５円０４銭）高の６万３６８４円６９銭まで上昇。ただ、日米欧で金融政策決定会合を控えるうえ、ここから始まる米ハイパースケーラーや国内主要企業の決算を見極めたいとされ、中盤からは伸び悩んだ。

・米アンソロピックの新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）申請を受け、米国でハイテク株が上昇した流れが東京市場にも波及。

・ＡＩ・半導体関連株が全体の上昇を先導。ＫＯＳＰＩの上昇も追い風となる。

・米ハイパースケーラー、国内ＡＩ関連企業の決算を見極めたいとのムードがあり、後場は伸び悩む可能性も。

・ＴＯＰＩＸは０．５８％高の３９９６．１７ポイントで午前の取引を終了。東証プライム市場の売買代金は３兆４０２１億０４００万円。

・東証３３業種では、値上がりは電気機器、非鉄金属など１３業種、値下がりは不動産業、医薬品、陸運業など２０業種。

・個別では、アドバンテスト、キオクシアホールディングス、東京エレクトロンなどが上昇。半面、リクルートホールディングス、第一三共などがさえない。

・東証プライム市場の騰落数は、値上がりが７０２銘柄（４５％）、値下がりは８０２銘柄（５１％）、変わらずは４７銘柄（３％）。

＜野村証券　ストラテジスト　秋山渉氏＞

「ＡＩ・半導体関連の好材料によって市場の雰囲気は落ち着きを取り戻した。原油価格がやや低下したことも好材料になる」

「日経平均の寄与度上位はＡＩ・半導体株が占め、一極集中とまでは言わないものの、これらが上昇をリードしているのは確かだ」

「日米欧はいずれも利上げ見送りで織り込んでおり、目先的に相場の方向性を決めるのは米ハイパースケーラーの決算となりそうだ」

item.title: Rupee boxed in range; traders focus on oil, outflows and RBI's defence
item.description: The Indian rupee seesawed in a narrow range against the dollar on Tuesday before ending little changed, while underlying sentiment remained weak.
item.dc:creator: Dharamraj Dhutia
item.content:encoded: The Indian rupee seesawed in a narrow range against the dollar on Tuesday before ending little changed, while underlying sentiment remained weak. The rupee ended at 95.1150 per dollar, up less than 0.1% from 95.1850 on Monday. Persistent external pressures from higher oil prices and equity outflows have left the currency reliant on Reserve Bank of India intervention for support, traders said. India should not "fixate on a number" for its currency level or run down foreign exchange reserves to defend the rupee, former Reserve Bank of India governor [USN:L6N46D0A3 TEXT:"Raghuram Rajan"], told Reuters on Tuesday. The central bank has [USN:L1N461073 TEXT:"spent around $80 billion"] to bolster the local currency since June. Benchmark Brent crude oil was hovering close to its highest levels in the last six months, around $117 per barrel in Asian hours, pushing importers to increase their hedging bets. India relies on imports for around 90% of its oil requirements. High prices add to concerns over Asia's third largest economy's outlook, with implications for foreign portfolio outflows and the nation's current account balance. Foreign investors have net sold around $8.5 billion of Indian equities in the last two months, a major drag on the rupee. Equity market volatility, currency concerns and the return on offer from dollar-denominated fixed income investments are encouraging investors to reassess equity-concentrated portfolios, said Sachin Sawrikar, Managing Partner at GIFT City-based Artha Bharat Investment Managers. Meanwhile, traders said elevated US Treasury yields have also been putting pressure on the local currency, as investors are not able to find a decent carry for their investments risks. Viram Shah, CEO at fintech company Vested, said with the 10-year US yield around 5%, fixed-income instruments have become more relevant for investors. Traders said the central bank's tolerance for a measured weakening in the rupee would be closely watched in the near-term. The RBI's intervention, along with [USN:L1N45W00Y TEXT:"measures"] to curb dollar buying helped the local currency recover earlier this month after it neared a record low hit in May.

item.description: [ロンドン ２７日 ロイター] - 英小売協会（ＢＲＣ）が２７日発表した１０月の小売価格は前年同月比２．１％上昇した。...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
英小売価格、10月は前年比＋2.1％　2年半超ぶり上昇率＝ＢＲＣ 11:37 配信

写真は3月27日、英ロンドンで撮影。 REUTERS/Jaimi Joy（ロイター） [ロンドン ２７日 ロイター] - 英小売協会（ＢＲＣ）が２７日発表した１０月の小売価格は前年同月比２．１％上昇した。上昇率は９月の１．４％から加速し、２０２４年２月以来の大きさとなった。

ＢＲＣは、小売業者がコスト上昇の影響を吸収することが次第に困難になっていると警告した。

ＢＲＣのヘレン・ディキンソン最高責任者は「小売業者はこの２年間、押し寄せる大幅なコスト増を吸収してきたが、その防波堤が決壊し始めている」と述べた上で、ヒーリー財務相に対し、２８日に発表する就任後初の年次予算案で小売業者の不動産税負担と雇用コストを軽減するよう求めた。

１０月の食品価格上昇率は２．９％と、９月の２．５％から加速し、４月以来の高水準となった。常温食品の価格上昇率は３．２％と、９月の２．２％から加速し、２５年９月以来の高水準。

非食品の価格上昇率は１．７％と、０．８％から加速し、２３年１２月以来の高水準となった。家具、床材、住宅改修用品の価格が特に大きく上昇した。

イングランド銀行（中央銀行）のベイリー総裁は今月、２２年のロシアによるウクライナ侵攻後と異なり、これまでのところ、米国とイランの戦争に伴うエネルギーコストの上昇を企業がおおむね吸収しており、利上げの必要性が低下していると述べていた。

item.title: Indian equity benchmarks muted as elevated oil, Fed in focus
item.description: Indian equity benchmarks ended little changed on Tuesday as elevated oil prices kept sentiments cautious, with investors awaiting the Federal Reserve's policy decision later this week.
item.dc:creator: Vivek M, Bharath Rajeswaran
item.content:encoded: Indian equity benchmarks ended little changed on Tuesday as elevated oil prices kept sentiments cautious, with investors awaiting the Federal Reserve's policy decision later this week. The Nifty 50 (.NSEI) fell 0.02% to 22,749.75, and the Sensex (.BSESN) shed 0.01% to 73,598.67. Brent crude traded near $116 per barrel, close to six-month high levels, as attacks on Saudi Arabia dampened hopes of an immediate easing of regional tensions. India's broader small-caps (.NIFSMCP100) and mid-caps (.NIFMDCP100) rose 2.7% and 1%, respectively. Gains there were driven by a post-earnings jump in [USN:L3N46D09D TEXT:"Sona BLW"] (SONB.NS) , [USN:L3N46D0CV TEXT:"Ather Energy"] (ATHR.NS) and [USN:L3N46D0AO TEXT:"Mankind Pharma"] (MNKI.NS) , and buying in [USN:L3N46D0HU TEXT:"defence"] stocks after the acquisition panel's clearance of over $22 billion worth of proposals. Twelve of the 16 major sectors logged gains. Investors' focus this week is on the [USN:L6N46606V TEXT:"Fed"], which is expected to keep rates steady on Wednesday, before resuming its tightening cycle in December as inflation worries loom. "A hawkish stance could keep global financial conditions tight, weigh on emerging-market flows and create near-term volatility," said Thomas Priju, portfolio manager at Karma Capital. The Nifty 50 has lost about 13% so far in 2026, on course for its worst performance in over a decade as soaring crude oil prices fueled by the Middle East war and a [USN:L4N45V07Q TEXT:"lack of large AI exposure"] have propelled record foreign outflows. As the world's third-largest crude oil importer, India is particularly vulnerable to higher oil prices, which intensify inflationary pressures, strain the fiscal balance, and squeeze corporate profitability. Heavyweight financials (.NIFTYFIN) and information technology stocks (.NIFTYIT) fell 0.6% and 0.3%, while auto (.NIFTYAUTO) and pharma stocks (.NIPHARM) rose 1.5% and 1.9%. [USN:L3N46C0SM TEXT:"Tata Consumer Products"] (TACN.NS) rose 6.8% after reporting better-than-expected second-quarter profit, helped by steady demand for its packaged foods and beverages as the company expands beyond traditional tea and salt businesses.

SEOUL, Oct 27 : South Korea's semiconductor exports could fall by $50 billion to $100 billion compared with earlier forecasts if capital spending on artificial intelligence by major US technology firms slows next year, according to central bank data. In a written response submitted to lawmaker Ahn Do-geol, the Bank of Korea (BOK) modelled a "pessimistic scenario" to assess the economic fallout if US tech giants curb their aggressive infrastructure outlays. Under the scenario, a sudden export shortfall would shave approximately 0.4 per centage point off South Korea's gross domestic product (GDP) growth rate next year, by driving the country's current account surplus well below the central bank's initial projection of $430 billion for 2027. The scenario assumed a 10 per cent decline in Korean semiconductor unit prices.

The assessment underscores growing anxiety over South Korea's heavy reliance on chips, which account for roughly half of its exports. The report said combined capital expenditure by five major US technology firms, Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Meta, and Oracle, has been growing rapidly, from $40 billion last year to an estimated $80 billion this year, and is projected to reach $110 billion next year. However, the BOK cautioned that considerable uncertainty remains over the trajectory of AI demand and the broader memory chip business cycle.

item.title: Dollar firms ahead of central bank meetings, steadier stocks stall safe haven play
item.description: The dollar nudged higher on the euro, yen and pound on Tuesday, as traders braced for a barrage of major central bank meetings that will shape the interest rate outlook, as well as key corporate earnings that could ripple through all asset classes.
item.dc:creator: Alun John
item.content:encoded: The dollar nudged higher on the euro, yen and pound on Tuesday, as traders braced for a barrage of major central bank meetings that will shape the interest rate outlook, as well as key corporate earnings that could ripple through all asset classes. The Federal Reserve is set to announce its latest policy decision on Wednesday, the European Central Bank is up on Thursday, and the Bank of Japan rounds out the week on Friday. All three are expected to keep rates on hold, so the focus will be on any hints policymakers give on their outlook. Also helping the dollar, especially on safe havens like the yen and Swiss franc, was greater calm in the equity market which was roiled last week by renewed worries about high-flying AI stocks. "The dollar has found good support early this week, as stabilising AI-related sentiment has allowed markets to reconnect with the broader supportive backdrop of a hawkish Federal Reserve and high energy prices," said Francesco Pesole, currency analyst at ING. The US currency was up 0.16% on the yen at 157.73 , while the euro slid 0.17% to $1.1154 and the pound dipped 0.14% to $1.3324. Pesole also said he thought markets were positioning ahead of the Fed meeting, anticipating Chair Kevin Warsh will reiterate his commitment to fighting inflation, something that will reinforce the floor under the dollar. Several other factors are in the mix as well and a key gauge of Japan's service-sector inflation [USN:L3N46D002 TEXT:"rose"] 3.7% in September from a year earlier, data showed on Tuesday, a sign of increasing price pressures that will likely keep the central bank on track for further interest rate hikes. Also in Japan, Finance Minister [USN:L2N46D03K TEXT:"Satsuki Katayama "]said on Tuesday the government stood ready to take decisive action in the currency market, reminding markets of Tokyo's willingness to intervene to prop up its currency. TECH EARNINGS IMPACT The broader market story will also be tested by a number of corporate earnings this week including from AI hyperscalers Alphabet (GOOGL.O) , Microsoft (MSFT.O) and Amazon.com (AMZN.O) . The yen was among the best-performing major currencies last week, strengthening around 0.75% on the dollar, its most since early September, as AI jitters in the equity market spurred a rush into the currency. Meanwhile, the euro was on track to be the worst-performing developed market currency in October, down 1.5% on the dollar, bruised by high energy costs, and the volatility in French government bonds and worries about France's fiscal position. The [USN:L6N4690QQ TEXT:"Reserve Bank of New Zealand"] and the Bank of Canada also announce their policy decisions on Wednesday, with both expected to raise interest rates. The RBNZ meets on Wednesday, and the New Zealand dollar was outperforming ahead of that, up 0.1% on the dollar on Tuesday at $0.5687. The Canadian dollar was steady at $1.4021 to its US counterpart .

item.title: Russia, Ukraine begin Oleshky ceasefire but keep up strikes elsewhere
item.description: Russia and Ukraine have begun a regional ceasefire to allow the start of a humanitarian effort in the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky, but they continue strikes elsewhere, including the Ukrainian capital of Kyiv.
item.dc:creator: Jekaterina Golubkova
item.content:encoded: Russia and Ukraine have begun a regional ceasefire to allow the start of a humanitarian effort in the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky, both sides said on Tuesday, but they continue strikes elsewhere, including the Ukrainian capital of Kyiv. The [USN:L1N46911P TEXT:"ceasefire"] should enable deliveries of aid as well as evacuations from the frontline town in southern Ukraine that is grappling with acute shortages of food and medicine. "As head of the Ukrainian negotiating team, I confirm that the Ukrainian side is honouring its commitments," Dmytro Lubinets, the parliamentary commissioner for human rights, said in a Facebook post confirming Russia's timing of its halt. On Telegram, Russia's defence ministry said it stopped shelling in the direction of Ukraine's city of Kherson from 4 a.m. Moscow time (0100 GMT), to prepare for the effort in Oleshky, which faces Kherson across the Dnipro River. Lubinets added that the deal was reached in coordination with US First Lady Melania Trump in cooperation with Russia's commissioner for human rights, Yana Lantratova. NEW STRIKES ON KYIV FORCE TRAFFIC HALT New strikes on Tuesday hit the Southern Bridge and subway infrastructure in Kyiv, forcing a suspension of traffic, city officials [USN:P8N44K01G TEXT:"said"], while a Reuters witness heard explosions. Oleshky [USN:L2N46C0BA TEXT:"lies"] on the eastern bank of the Dnipro in Ukraine's southern region of Kherson, opposite the city of Kherson, which is held by Ukrainian forces. But Russian troops have controlled the town since seizing it during the first days of their February 2022 invasion. White House envoys have [USN:L1N4690TJ TEXT:"talked"] to both sides in recent days to try and find a solution as the US looks to mediate a peace deal to end the war, Europe's deadliest conflict since the World War Two. On Friday, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said peace negotiators from Ukraine, Russia and the United States had agreed to meet at a technical level in the first half of November in Abu Dhabi to continue the talks. FRESH ATTACKS A Russian missile [USN:L2N46C0Y8 TEXT:"attack"] on Kyiv killed at least one and injured 15, including students in a dormitory, since Monday evening. The attacks [USN:L2N46C0SM TEXT:"also"] killed and injured people in the cities of Kharkiv and Pavlohrad. On the Telegram messaging app, the Russian defence ministry said it has hit transport infrastructure in Kyiv, a logistics hub in the Kharkiv region as well as industrial facilities and cargo vessels elsewhere it cited as being put to military use. A drone attack [USN:P8N44K01I TEXT:"killed"] a man and wounded six people in the western Russian city of Bryansk close to the border with Ukraine. Another person was killed and 30 [USN:P8N44K01H TEXT:"injured"] as a drone hit a bus in the Russian-controlled part of Ukraine's southeastern region of Zaporizhzhia, local officials said. Reuters could not immediately independently verify the reports. Russia and Ukraine deny deliberately targeting civilians.

item.title: European shares dip as HSBC results weigh on banks ahead of Big Tech earnings
item.description: European shares slipped on Tuesday, dragged down by banking stocks, after disappointing results from HSBC, while investors also turned cautious ahead of US tech earnings, seen as a key test of the AI trade, and central bank meetings that could shape near-term interest-rate outlook.
item.dc:creator: Johann Cherian, Ankur Banerjee
item.content:encoded: European shares slipped on Tuesday, dragged down by banking stocks, after disappointing results from HSBC, while investors also turned cautious ahead of US tech earnings, seen as a key test of the AI trade, and central bank meetings that could shape near-term interest-rate outlook. The STOXX 600 banking sector (.SX7P) slid 1.3%, with shares of Europe's largest lender (HSBA.L) down 7% after [USN:L2N46D02S TEXT:"missing revenue expectations"] for the July-September quarter due to slower growth at its wealth business, while pretax profit was in line with estimates. The pan-European STOXX 600 (.STOXX) dipped 0.2%, while London's FTSE 100 index (.FTSE) declined 1%, largely as a result of the drop in HSBC shares. "Banks have been the winners of the latest quarter before this one, reporting record results because of high volatility and because of AI financing," said Ipek Ozkardeskaya, a senior market analyst at Swissquote Bank. "But right now, they are coming under pressure because we do see the interest rate rise, short-term yields rising more than long-term; that's basically eating into the income revenue," she added. "But I still think that the banks are in a good position to outperform the other sectors, especially sectors that are more vulnerable to directly rising living costs." Quarterly earnings are the central focus globally, as investors weigh up the impact of the conflict in Iran, including higher costs and interest rates, on corporate performance. EARNINGS DELUGE In the US this week, more than a third of S&P 500 companies are expected to report and the scrutiny of AI hyperscalers including Microsoft (MSFT.O) , Amazon (AMZN.O) and Alphabet (GOOGL.O) will be intense, as investors seek signs that these companies' billion-dollar investments are yielding returns as expected. "We remain medium-term bullish on the 'picks and shovels' trade. We see capex cycle remaining strong and the earnings remaining robust," Mohit Kumar, an economist at Jefferies, said. "However, we do admit that, as with any cycle, there would be winners and losers in the AI trade and a number of companies will not remain profitable and even go bust." Big Tech earnings could determine appetite for the eagerly awaited public debut of AI bellwether [USN:L6N46C148 TEXT:"Anthropic"] and Meta Platforms' (META.O) $95-billion equity fundraising. Claude-owner Anthropic disclosed a steep loss, but red-hot revenue growth, in its filing for a US initial public offering on Monday and is expected to list before the end of November. The enthusiasm around Anthropic lifted stocks in Asia and helped MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan (.MIAPJ0000PUS) rise 0.1%. Nasdaq futures were muted after strong gains in the previous session. CENTRAL BANKS EXPECTED TO STAY ON HOLD Policy decisions from the [USN:L6N46518P TEXT:"Federal Reserve"], European Central Bank and [USN:L3N46C02N TEXT:"Bank of Japan"] are due later this week, with economists expecting all three to stand pat on interest rates, leaving the focus on comments from policymakers to gauge the rates outlook. Fed [USN:L6N46518P TEXT:"policymakers"] have telegraphed they will not raise short-term borrowing costs again on Wednesday, but with inflation concerns still front and centre, investors believe a rate-hike pause will not last for long. Traders are pricing in a 25 basis point hike from the Fed in December, the CME Group's FedWatch Tool showed. The euro eased 0.1% and at $1.115 it was near the May low it hit two weeks ago. The yield on the US 10-year Treasury note was steady at 4.986%, staying below 5% which it breached in September as investors scurried to Treasuries for safety during stock market tumult over AI worries. The outlook for interest rates could depend on the outcome of ongoing talks with Tehran, even as Yemen's Houthis continue to attack Saudi Arabia. Brent crude prices rose 0.6% to $116.82 per barrel. Spot gold prices [USN:L2N46D072 TEXT:"eased 0.6%"] to $3,992.70 per ounce.

item.title: K-pop agency JYP shares soar after little-known groups announce tender offer
item.description: Shares of JYP Entertainment , home to K-pop groups TWICE and Stray Kids, jumped more than 10% on Tuesday after two little-known investor groups said they were preparing a tender offer for up to 50% of the company.
item.dc:creator: Hyunjoo Jin
item.content:encoded: Shares of JYP Entertainment (035900.KQ) , home to K-pop groups TWICE and Stray Kids, jumped more than 10% on Tuesday after two little-known investor groups said they were preparing a tender offer for up to 50% of the company. NEXROC Group and SVCV Inc plan to launch a tender offer in November for a 25% to 50% stake in JYP at a 30% premium to a benchmark share price, the Japan- and China-based groups said in a statement. JYP said it had not received a tender offer. The Financial Supervisory Service (FSS), South Korea's financial watchdog, said in a statement on Tuesday that it was highly unusual to announce publicly an intention to launch a tender offer before filing a tender offer registration statement. Noting JYP's share price had become more volatile since media reports of the plan, the FSS said it was closely watching for abnormal trading and rule violations, and would quickly open an investigation if it suspected unfair trading. It also said that, without a filing, it was difficult to verify details of the bidder and its funding, and the deal might not go ahead. It urged investors to beware of losses from share price swings. JYP has a current market value of about $1.06 billion, meaning a 50% stake would be worth about $530 million before factoring in the reported premium. UNUSUAL MOVE While an acquisition would give the investors a stake in one of South Korea's leading K-pop agencies, whose roster also includes ITZY and DAY6, analysts questioned whether the groups had secured sufficient financing for such a significant transaction. "A company has to launch a tender offer when they have enough financial backing/assets that would allow them to launch a tender offer," said Douglas Kim, an independent analyst who writes on investment research platform Smartkarma, adding that allowing such a pre-tender offer "could set a bad precedent in the Korean equity markets." Data platform PitchBook lists the NEXROC Group as early-stage venture capital-funded in 2025, with a most recent funding round of $25 million. NEXROC Group is evaluating 15 acquisition targets across multiple industries and geographies and aims to retain at least 51% equity ownership in its portfolio companies, according to its website. The group aims to build $200 billion in assets under management within a decade. "There are many doubts about what the company is," said Lee Nara, an analyst at Sangsangin Securities in Seoul. JYP was founded by South Korean singer-songwriter and producer Park Jin-young, known as J.Y. Park. Park owns 15.4% of the company. JYP shares, which rallied as much as 14%, trimmed earlier gains and closed up 6.8%. ($1 = 1,325.6500 won)

The 50 per cent stake is worth about 700 billion won ($528.04 million) based on JYP's current market capitalisation. JYP said it has not received a tender offer. NEW DELHI, Oct 27 : Oil prices turned positive on Tuesday after a fall of about 1 per cent, earlier in the session, as the chance of talks in Tehran eased fears of a broader Middle East supply shock, while renewed Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia highlighted persistent risks. Brent crude futures was up 40 cents, or 0.4 per cent, at $116.24 a barrel by 0718 GMT, while US West Texas Intermediate crude was up 30 cents, or 0.3 per cent, at $102.07. Both fell 1 per cent earlier in the session. Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan held talks with Iranian officials in Tehran on Monday aimed at easing tension in the Middle East. The four countries agreed to continue talks with a view to strengthening cooperation in peace and security, Iranian state media said.

"Prices remain elevated amid persistent geopolitical uncertainties," said Sugandha Sachdeva, founder of SS WealthStreet, a New Delhi-based research firm, adding that some profit taking earlier in the session was fuelled by hopes of a breakthrough in talks between the US and Iran, she said. Last week, Brent prices surged to more than $117 a barrel, the highest since April, after a wave of Iranian attacks on tankers around the Strait of Hormuz. Brent prices touched $117 on Monday as well. Scope for peace looked fragile, however, with renewed attacks by Iran-aligned Houthis on key producer Saudi Arabia. October has been the worst month for attacks on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz and nearby waterways, data from a Washington-based think tank shows, among worldwide maritime security incidents it has tracked since 2017. The war rippling across the Middle East has brought into focus the narrow waterway of the Strait of Hormuz, which carried about a fifth of global energy supplies before the conflict erupted in February. The oil market is vulnerable with stress across areas such as supply, logistics, inventories and refining, ANZ Research said in a note. Gulf crude exports fell for a fourth straight week and flows through the Strait of Hormuz were just about 60 per cent of their normal level, while global distillate inventories held nearly 5 per cent below their five-year average, it added.

FAST

TOKYO: Japan's core consumer price index, which strips out one-off factors, rose in September at the fastest annual pace in three years, data showed on Tuesday (Oct 27), a sign of broadening price pressures that cement the case for further interest rate hikes. The data comes ahead of the Bank of Japan's two-day policy meeting that ends on Friday, when the central bank is set to keep interest rates steady at 1.25 per cent but signal its readiness to keep raising borrowing costs on mounting risks of inflation. The index, which excludes "institutional factors" such as education and energy-related subsidies, jumped 3.2 per cent in September from a year earlier, BOJ data showed, accelerating from a rise of 2.6 per cent in August. The index rise is the biggest year-on-year since October 2023.

The index is compiled by the BOJ to better gauge underlying inflation, or price moves driven by domestic demand that strips out the effect of government subsidies and other one-off steps. It is different from the government's core consumer price index, which excludes volatile fresh food costs but does not strip out the impact of subsides and other government steps. Separate data from the BOJ earlier on Tuesday showed a key gauge of service-sector inflation rose 3.7 per cent in September from a year earlier, suggesting that companies are passing on rising labour costs to service-related prices. "The data shows companies are passing on prices at the business-to-business level reflecting the strong outcome of this year's wage negotiations," said Kenichiro Ahara, an economist at Dai-ichi Life Research Institute. The annual rise in the services producer price index, which tracks the prices companies charge each other for services, followed a revised 3.5 per cent gain in August. A jump of 97.7 per cent in ocean freight transport costs was among key drivers of the increase, as the weak yen and Middle East conflict boosted the cost of importing fuel, the data showed. Still, prices of labour-incentive sectors continued to rise steadily in a sign of broadening price pressures, analysts said. The BOJ has said it focuses on underlying inflation in deciding the pace and timing of future interest rate hikes.

item.title: Netanyahu's political survival on the line as Israel votes
item.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu faces a fight for political survival on Tuesday in an election seen by many Israelis as the most consequential in the country's history and a referendum on his leadership since the 2023 Hamas-led attacks.
item.dc:creator: Steven Scheer, Pesha Magid
item.content:encoded: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu faces a fight for political survival on Tuesday in an election seen by many Israelis as the most consequential in the country's history and a referendum on his leadership since the 2023 [USN:L8N4680E4 TEXT:"Hamas-led attacks"]. The vote follows a turbulent period for Israel, shaped by the trauma of the October 7 attacks, wars in Gaza, Lebanon and with Iran, deepening international isolation, and the divisive policies of Netanyahu's right-wing coalition. Yet Netanyahu, Israel's longest-serving leader with 19 years in office, remains a formidable survivor, with nationalist politics increasingly entrenched and Israel's fragmented system potentially leaving him best placed to form a government. Opinion polls show a close race between Netanyahu's Likud party and its right-wing allies and a rival alliance led by [USN:L6N46303T TEXT:"Gadi Eisenkot"], a former military chief of staff and security hawk with backers on the right and in the centre. Voters began casting ballots after polling stations opened at 7 a.m. (0500 GMT). The polls close at 10 p.m. (2000 GMT). Netanyahu has campaigned on his wartime leadership and his alliance with US President Donald Trump , who has endorsed him and joined Israel in waging war on Iran . Netanyahu said on Sunday that Trump was prepared to act again to "finally" remove the Iranian threat, but only if Netanyahu remained in power. Eisenkot has accused Netanyahu of "relying on a campaign of fear-mongering, lies and threats" and said he was confident Trump would work "in full cooperation with any leader chosen by the people." Netanyahu may again depend on far-right leaders Itamar Ben-Gvir and Bezalel Smotrich to form a government. Both have faced sanctions from some Western countries that accuse them of inciting violence against Palestinians, while [USN:L8N45T0L1 TEXT:"Ben-Gvir's Jewish Power"] party has gained support in opinion polls. Neither Netanyahu nor Eisenkot has a clear path to power. If neither can form a governing coalition in the 120-seat parliament, Netanyahu could stay on as caretaker until another election is held next year. The Israeli Central Election Committee said 7.3 million Israelis are eligible to vote, some 330,000 of them for the first time. SEEKING A 'NEW DAY' For many of Netanyahu's opponents, the election turns on [USN:L8N4680E4 TEXT:"accountability"] for the security failures of October 7, Israel's deadliest day. Opposition groups have promised a national inquiry. Eldad Shaaltiel, a volunteer with Eisenkot's Yashar party, said he had come early to hang campaign posters outside a Jerusalem polling station, aiming to sway the potentially critical pool of still wavering voters. Some 13% of Israeli voters have yet to decide how they will vote, according to data collected by the Viterbi Family Center for Public Opinion and Policy Research at the Israel Democracy Institute. Nilli Mor, a volunteer for the Democrats party led by former general Yair Golan, another opponent of Netanyahu, said she was campaigning "to try and bring a new day to Israel, a better day with hope and great change for this country". A high turnout among voters from [USN:L8N45Z09Z TEXT:"Israel's Arab minority"] — Israeli by citizenship but Palestinian by heritage — could help nudge Israel's complex coalition arithmetic in favour of Eisenkot. Though Eisenkot has ruled out partnering with Arab parties, citing a lack of shared values, analysts see a scenario where they could prop up a minority government he leads in order to ensure Netanyahu is removed from office. But Ben-Gvir, casting his vote in the Kiryat Arba settlement in the occupied West Bank early on Tuesday, predicted Netanyahu would return as prime minister, adding: "We will serve as the right-wing anchor of that government". In some [USN:L8N45Y0MD TEXT:"bastions of Likud"] support, disenchanted voters have been going door to door to turn voters against Netanyahu. Some have turned away from Netanyahu as he battles corruption charges he denies in a long-running criminal trial. "My expectation is that we will have only a slight majority either way. No landslide," said Israeli political analyst Amotz Asa-El of the Shalom Hartman Institute. THE WARTIME RECORD Eisenkot joined Netanyahu's war cabinet after the October 7 attacks but quit after eight months, criticising his leadership. Israel flattened much of Gaza in the offensive launched after October 7, when Hamas-led militants killed 1,200 people and took another 251 hostage. Gaza health authorities say Israeli attacks killed 74,000 people. Israel also dealt heavy blows to Iran-backed Hezbollah in Lebanon and traded strikes with Iran before a 12-day aerial campaign against Iranian nuclear sites in 2025 and this year's joint US-Israeli war. Eisenkot has said Israel's next government must prevent Iran from acquiring a military nuclear capability, either by force or through an "arrangement" such as a US-backed diplomatic solution. Like nearly all Jewish-led parties in Israel, Eisenkot opposes the two-state solution that underpinned decades of peace negotiations with the Palestinians. But he has criticised Jewish settler violence against Palestinians in the Israeli-occupied West Bank, which has surged since 2023 and strained Israel's ties with Western states. And he opposes Netanyahu's far-right coalition partners Ben-Gvir and Smotrich.

item.title: Ben & Jerry's founders explore deal to separate brand from owner, WSJ reports (Oct 26)
item.description: Ben & Jerry's founders Ben Cohen and Jerry Greenfield are exploring a deal to separate their brand from its current owner, the Wall Street Journal reported on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ben & Jerry's founders Ben Cohen and Jerry Greenfield are exploring a deal to separate their brand from its current owner, the Wall Street Journal reported on Monday. The ice cream brand is owned by Unilever (ULVR.L) spin-off Magnum Ice Cream (MICCT.AS) . The co-founders have been discussing a deal with Pete Stavros, founder of Expanding ESOPs, to carve out the business and structure it under an employee stock-ownership plan, WSJ said, citing Stavros and Cohen. The structure would give rank-and-file employees stock while providing the company with tax benefits, the report added. But any deal would need to be approved by Ben & Jerry's owner Magnum, which told Reuters in an emailed statement that "Ben & Jerry's is not for sale and, more importantly, is thriving as part of The Magnum Ice Cream Company." "Taking Ben & Jerry's out of Magnum would drive significant dis-synergies, investment in the social mission would fall, and selling prices per unit would inflate," it added. Ben & Jerry's has a history of vocal social activism and its founders and board have [USN:L6N40E1GS TEXT:"repeatedly clashed"] with former parent Unilever over political and ethical stances. Magnum has also looked to [USN:L1N41J0MN TEXT:"weaken the control"] of Ben & Jerry's independent board. The company currently has five members on its independent board. Cohen told the WSJ that "all he could do is try to generate more public pressure on Magnum to sell." Ben & Jerry's and representatives for the co-founders and Stravos did not immediately respond to Reuters requests for comment.

FAST

NEW YORK: US stocks closed higher on Monday (Oct 26), with the S&P 500 and Nasdaq coming off consecutive weekly declines, as Anthropic's IPO filing helped boost sentiment in AI-related stocks in a week filled with a host of market catalysts. Anthropic disclosed steep losses and red-hot revenue growth in its filing for a US initial public offering, laying out its ambition to build AI systems capable of reshaping the global economy despite the high costs of developing the technology. The AI lab is pushing ahead with its listing plans even as a once-lively autumn IPO calendar has slowed, with recent market volatility prompting companies to delay offerings. Anthropic's filing comes as investors increasingly dissect the potential payoff from massive AI spending and at the start of an eventful week. On tap are the Federal Reserve's policy statement on Wednesday, readings on economic growth and inflation on Thursday and a slew of corporate earnings reports throughout the week.

More than a third of S&P 500 companies are scheduled to report earnings this week, including hyperscalers Alphabet, Microsoft and Amazon.com, whose results will be parsed for signs of whether the hefty AI investments are translating into growth. "Today's all about the Anthropic release, so we're back on a little bit of an optimistic tilt, I would say. But there's a lot in that release. It will be interesting to see how well things are received when they actually come to list," said JP Powers, chief investment officer at RWA Wealth Partners in Boston. "The risk is maybe a little bit of a whipsaw if things aren't all moving in the same direction. A little optimism today, but who knows what will happen from some of these other releases this week," he said. According to preliminary data, the S&P 500 gained 53.35 points, or 0.70 per cent, to end at 7,677.03 points, while the Nasdaq Composite gained 214.02 points, or 0.83 per cent, to 26,169.38. The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 146.60 points, or 0.28 per cent, to 52,361.76. Semiconductor and chip-related companies, widely viewed as some of the biggest beneficiaries of the AI boom, helped fuel the gains. The broader Philadelphia chips index was up about 3 per cent on the day but is still down nearly 12 per cent on the month.

Related:

Anthropic quietly pitches its own AI safety Bill to US lawmakers

Commentary: PHP vulnerabilities - why the good guys have notched a victory in AI-cybersecurity age

Meta said on Monday it plans to raise up to US$95 billion in equity to fund its AI-related expansion of data centers, cloud computing power and other infrastructure. The AI trade has come under pressure this month amid concerns that debt-funded spending may become harder to justify in the face of climbing borrowing costs. The Anthropic filing helped buoy sentiment, however, as neocloud firms, including CoreWeave, erased earlier declines. Other AI-linked companies, including photonic product makers Lumentum and Coherent, were among the best-performing S&P 500 stocks. The technology index led gains among the 11 major S&P 500 sectors. Megacap and growth stocks were also mostly higher. Tesla jumped to its highest intraday level in more than three months after Barclays upgraded its rating on the stock to "overweight" from "equal-weight". Markets are pricing in only a 12.7 per cent chance of a rate hike from the Fed on Wednesday, according to CME FedWatch. But with inflation pressures showing no signs of abating, market participants do not believe the central bank will be on hold for long. Investors are also bracing for the Nov 3 midterm elections, which will decide control of the US Congress.

Source: Reuters/fs/dy

item.title: Republicans bet Musk’s millions can rescue Texas' Paxton in US Senate race
item.description: Texas Democrats' best chance at a statewide win in more than three decades is facing a wall of Republican money, with Elon Musk and other donors pouring hundreds of millions into a late effort to rescue Senate candidate Ken Paxton.
item.dc:creator: Brad Brooks, Andy Sullivan, Arathy Somasekhar
item.content:encoded: Texas Democrats' best chance at a statewide win in more than three decades is facing a wall of Republican money, with Elon Musk and other donors pouring hundreds of millions into a late effort to rescue Senate candidate Ken Paxton. With two weeks until the November 3 election and early voting under way, however, it is unclear how much impact the spending can still have. Polls show few undecided voters remain, and Republicans say their biggest challenge is turning out their own voters, many of whom are frustrated by the cost of living and the war with Iran launched by President Donald Trump, who has endorsed Paxton. "The money being spent now isn't for persuasion. It's for mobilization," said pollster James Henson, director of the Texas Politics Project at the University of Texas. "In most of the statewide polling we've seen, Republicans are suffering from an enthusiasm gap." Republican strategists say internal polling shows that gap has narrowed considerably. "We've seen it collapse, thank God. It was one of our concerns," said Dave Carney, a longtime Republican strategist and chief adviser to Texas Governor Greg Abbott. That turnout challenge helps explain the tone of Republican advertising. Rather than focusing on inflation and the economy, which polls consistently show are among voters' top concerns, Republicans in Texas and other battleground states have leaned heavily on culture-war themes to energize their base. Republican groups have spent more than $100 million nationally since August 1 on more than 200 ads accusing Democrats of backing “sex change” procedures for children, according to an analysis of AdImpact data by FactCheck.org. TEXAS-SIZED SPENDING Combined advertising spending in the race between Paxton, the state's Republican attorney general, and Democrat James Talarico has topped $500 million, according to ad-tracking data, putting it on pace to become the most expensive US Senate contest ever. Talarico has held a small but consistent lead over Paxton, though generally within the margin of error, making it Texas' most competitive statewide race since 1994, Henson said. Outside groups backing Paxton have spent about $239 million, more than five times the roughly $45 million spent by the largest Democratic-aligned groups. Texas PAC, a Republican super PAC, alone has accounted for nearly $149 million. The group was launched by the Senate Leadership Fund, the main Republican Senate super PAC. Musk, who lives in Texas and has relocated SpaceX, Tesla, X and other businesses there, has contributed $158 million to the Senate Leadership Fund, which subsequently transferred matching sums to Texas PAC, according to federal filings. Talarico has offset the outside-spending disadvantage with grassroots fundraising. His campaign says it raised $64 million from July through September, more than triple Paxton's total, with 97% of donations under $100. He spent $61 million on ads through September, according to AdImpact, while the biggest Democratic outside group, Lone Star Rising PAC, has spent $19.3 million. The influx of Republican money arrived relatively late in the campaign, with Trump's MAGA Inc. super PAC not beginning major spending until early September. "I think the cavalry arrived just in the nick of time for Paxton," said Republican donor and oil businessman Dan Eberhart. GOING NEGATIVE Much of that spending has funded attacks portraying Talarico as out of step with Texas voters on culture-war issues. Independent fact checkers say the ads distort Talarico's record, and Henson said their goal is “arousing negative sentiment among Republican voters” to boost turnout. Texas PAC ads tell voters that Talarico is "for they/them, not you" and accuse him of supporting taxpayer-funded sex-change surgeries for minors. PolitiFact rated that claim false, noting that while Talarico opposed a 2023 ban on gender-transition care for minors, he has said he opposes gender-reassignment surgery for children. A Paxton campaign ad featured an AI-generated Talarico reading from a fictional "King James (Talarico) Bible" that combined excerpts of his past remarks, including one describing God as "nonbinary." FactCheck.org said the ad lacked key context. Talarico has responded by casting Paxton as "the most corrupt politician in Texas." Paxton was impeached by the Republican-controlled Texas House in 2023 on abuse-of-office allegations but was acquitted by the state Senate. Separate state securities-fraud charges dating to 2015 were dropped in 2024 under an agreement requiring community service, ethics training and restitution. Paxton denied wrongdoing. The Paxton campaign did not respond to requests for comment. It has previously said Talarico raises the allegations to distract from his own record. Some voters say the Republican attacks are unconvincing. Sal Anthony Rodriguez, a 32-year-old Houston operations manager who voted for Trump in 2020 and 2024, said he now supports Talarico, partly because of what he views as misleading attacks. "I've seen a lot of ads saying that he is in 100% support for transgender surgeries on kids, and a quick Google search showed that that was not accurate," Rodriguez said. Democrats argue the focus on cultural issues reflects Republican difficulty addressing voters' economic concerns. "Voters are really pissed off about the state of their lives right now, and you can only run so many trans ads at people who are sick of paying $6 for diesel," said Chuck Rocha, a senior adviser to the Talarico campaign.

item.title: UBS says it does not permit the use of external AI models for client transactions
item.description: UBS will not allow the use of external AI models to execute actions on behalf of clients, CEO Sergio Ermotti said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: UBS (UBSG.S) will not allow the use of external AI models to execute actions on behalf of clients, CEO Sergio Ermotti said on Tuesday. Concerns that sophisticated AI agents could harm the financial system have risen within the banking industry. Major US banks have been [USN:L6N4680PX TEXT:"blocking"] third-party AI agents' access to customer accounts, people familiar with the matter have said. "You heard recently some banks are being exposed to potential misbehaviors of models in managing clients' accounts and shifting deposits and optimizing deposits," Ermotti told a science conference. "We are not allowing models to enter into the bank and do that." "When you talk about AI, the most important issue right now is to make sure that we don't get AI models that drive outcomes for clients in a black box," Ermotti said. UBS' integration of fallen rival Credit Suisse, which it acquired in 2023, forced it to slow its deployment of AI somewhat, but now the lender can put even more emphasis on technology, Ermotti added. "I'm glad that we are almost over with the integration and therefore we can now put even more emphasis around technology and how we can help the bank become more effective and efficient."

item.title: テンセントがオラクルからAI半導体10万個をリース、70億ドル規模－FT
item.description:
（ブルームバーグ）： 中国のテンセント・ホールディングス（騰訊）は、東南アジアでオラクルから先端のAI半導体を借り受けることで合意した。テンセントにとってAI半導体のリース契約としては過去最大規模となる。英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（FT）が事情に詳しい関係者の話として報じた。
報道によると、テンセントは、5年間の契約の一環として10万個の半導体を利用できるようになる。契約額は70億ドル（約1兆1000億円）に上るという。
中国のAI開発企業は米国の輸出規制を回避するため、米エヌビディア製など中国国内では入手できないAIアクセラレーターを海外で借りて利用している。中国のテクノロジー企業は、東南アジアのデータセンターの最大顧客層の一つとなっている。
テンセントとオラクルの担当者は、ブルームバーグ・ニュースのコメント要請に直ちに応じなかった。
原題：Tencent Leases AI Chips From Oracle

item.title: 日銀｢主な意見｣で円下落、10月利上げの示唆乏しい－短観も決め手欠く
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 1日の外国為替市場で円が対ドルで下落した。日本銀行が公表した金融政策決定会合の「主な意見」は、10月の追加利上げの手がかりを期待していた投資家にとって物足りない内容となった。

円は一時ニューヨーク終値比0.5%安の158円22銭まで下落。主要10通貨（G10）で最も下げた。

外為どっとコム総合研究所の神田卓也シニア為替アナリストは、主な意見は「タカ派的な意見が多かったが、連続利上げ期待を強めるほどではなかった」と指摘。ただ、158円台では介入警戒感がドルの上値を抑える可能性が高いとみている。

日銀が31年ぶり高水準への政策金利引き上げを決めた9月会合の主な意見では、政策運営の重点がインフレ率の上振れを防ぐことに移っているとの認識が改めて示された。中立金利が市場推計値より上振れる可能性があることや、これまでの利上げによる影響は限定的だとみる企業が多いとの指摘があったほか、早期の政策金利引き上げが望ましいとの意見が示された。

翌日物金利スワップ（OIS）市場では、10月の利上げ確率が約20%と、一時30%を超えた前日から低下。一方、12月までの利上げは完全に織り込まれている。

債券市場では超長期債を中心に金利が上昇しており、市場がインフレ対応で日銀が後手に回ることを警戒している可能性を示唆する。

9月会合後は日銀が今後の利上げペースについてより強い指針を示さなかったとの受け止めから円安が進み、金融当局がニューヨーク時間に市場参加者に為替水準を照会するレートチェックを実施したと報じられた。財務省は9月30日、直近1カ月の為替介入額はゼロ円だったと公表した。

米国では連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）が先月、全会一致で利上げを決定し、年内にもう1回の追加利上げを支持する姿勢を示した。

オーストラリア・コモンウェルス銀行のストラテジスト、サマラ・ハムード氏は「日銀が市場の期待に応えるハードルは高い」と話す。「9月の利上げ決定で票が割れたことや、FRBがよりタカ派的になっていることを踏まえると、日銀がより明確なフォワードガイダンスを示さない限り、利上げ観測が円を支える効果は限られる」との見方を示した。

item.title: 高市政権、予算改革元年は「総力戦」で最適解探る－国債発行が鍵に
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 恒常的な補正予算から脱却する改革元年は、防衛費や投資枠などで歳出が膨張する一方、消費減税で歳入の減少が見込まれる。国債発行額も野放図に増やせない制約があり、政府は「総力戦」で歳出・歳入両面の精緻化を進める。

年末の閣議決定を目指す2027年度予算案は、高市早苗政権が概算要求段階から取り組む初めての当初予算となる。8月末に締め切った概算要求は143.1兆円だったが、このほかに金額を示さない事項要求もあり、実際の総額規模は見えづらい。

今回の予算編成では、これまで以上に政府の知恵が問われる。債券市場が高市財政に厳しい視線を投げかける中、想定を超える国債発行額となれば金利上昇につながる可能性があるためだ。片山さつき財務相は「国債発行額を市場の信認を得られるようなレベルにコントロールしていく」と強調するが、市場の許容度を推し量るのは容易ではない。

国債発行額を抑制する方法は、歳出を抑えるか、歳入を増やすしかない。歳出側では財務省主計局の査定能力が問われる。特に、成長投資のための「新たな投資枠」では、民間の動きを誘発できる案件にどれだけ絞り込めるのかが焦点だ。

歳入は主に財務省主税局による税収見積もりが鍵を握る。過去数年の税収は当初見積もりから上振れる傾向にあり、9月30日の経済財政諮問会議では、税収の分析で財務省と内閣府の連携を求める有識者提言が出た。当初予算編成の段階で税収見込みを増やせれば、国債発行額を抑える効果が見込める。

ただ、国債発行額を縮小する目的で税収の見積もり方法を変えれば、「恣意（しい）的」との批判を招く可能性もあり、慎重な判断が求められる。

税外収入をどれだけ積み上げられるかも重要だ。過去の事例を踏まえると、外国為替資金特別会計（外為特会）の剰余金を一般会計に全額繰り入れる手法が有力視されそうだ。

加えて、財務省理財局の視点が不可欠となる。従来の予算編成では、主計局が歳出の規模を決めるとともに主税局が税収を見積もり、理財局は最後に差額分を国債発行で埋め合わせるという、「帳尻合わせ」の役割を担ってきた。

item.title: トランプ氏、ディーゼル輸出禁止への意欲後退－ガソリン値上がり警戒
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： トランプ米大統領は米国産ディーゼル燃料の輸出禁止案について、予期せぬ価格高騰のリスクを踏まえ、実行に移す意欲が後退していることを示唆した。政権幹部の一人は、欧州が近くディーゼル燃料の供給を増やす可能性も示した。

トランプ氏は9月30日、記者団に対し、海外向けディーゼル燃料販売の規制についてライト・エネルギー長官、バーガム内務長官と引き続き検討していると説明。一方、広範な輸出禁止が意図しない結果を招きかねないとする両氏の懸念も認めた。

トランプ氏は「彼らはディーゼル燃料価格の抑制に多少役立つと考えているが、ほかのものの価格を押し上げる可能性がある。原油価格はこれから下がり始めるため、今は良い状況にあると思う」と指摘。「ガソリンには悪影響がありそうだ。ガソリン価格が少し上がり、ディーゼル燃料価格は少し下がる。われわれは非常に良い状態にあると考えている」とした。

ディーゼル燃料価格は記録的な上昇となっており、中間選挙を数週間後に控える米政権に圧力が強まっている。中間選挙で共和党は議会で多数派を失う可能性がある。特に生活費の高さを巡り、有権者のトランプ氏への評価は低い。

ライト氏は30日、高値を和らげる可能性のある動きとして、「欧州の友人たちから、市場に新たに供給されるディーゼル燃料について発表があるだろう」と述べた。

ホワイトハウス当局者は、輸出禁止には至らない個別対策も検討している。事情に詳しい関係者が内部協議を理由に匿名で語ったところでは、米国産ディーゼル燃料への依存度が高い欧州の一部の国に、在庫放出を促す案などがある。

米当局者は、イラン戦争を受けた石油備蓄の協調放出を巡り、欧州諸国の対応が米国や日本に比べ出遅れていると不満を示してきた。ライト氏は、欧州の複数国が「約束した原油と石油製品のごく一部しか放出していない」と述べている。

原題：Trump Downplays Diesel Export Ban Over Impact on Other Fuels（抜粋）

item.title: パイロットが意図的に墜落させた旅客機、過去の事例を振り返る
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： アラブ首長国連邦（UAE）のドバイを離陸しイスラエルのテルアビブに向かっていたフライドバイの旅客機内で、パイロットの1人が同僚を刺した疑いがあり、機体が急降下してサウジアラビアに緊急着陸する事態となったが、間一髪で大惨事を免れた。

この事件を受け、操縦室の乗務員のメンタルヘルスを巡る懸念が再燃し、過去に起きた操縦士による殺人・自殺事件が改めて注目されている。

こうした事例はまれだが、前例がないわけではない。米連邦航空局（FAA）が2014年に発表した調査報告によると、2003－2012年に発生した死者を伴う航空事故2758件のうち、8件が航空機を使った殺人・自殺と認定された。

ブルームバーグ・ニュースが2022年に行った調査では、航空機の信頼性が高まり、操縦士のミスも減る中で、操縦士が意図的に航空機を墜落させたことによる死者の割合が、航空機事故による死者全体の中で拡大していることが分かった。

意図的な行為は従来、航空機事故の統計には含まれていないが、ブルームバーグがまとめたデータによれば、仮に含めた場合、世界の航空機事故による死者の原因別で2番目に大きなカテゴリーとなる。

ロンドン行きのエア・インディア機がインドのアーメダバードを離陸して32秒後に墜落した。ボーイングの787ドリームライナーが空港敷地外の人口密集地に墜落し、乗客・乗員241人と地上の19人が死亡した。乗客1人が奇跡的に生還した。

インドの航空当局は最終報告書をまだ公表しておらず、この墜落事故がパイロットの自殺だったとも公式には確認していない。ただ、2025年7月に公表された暫定報告書によると、操縦室にある二つの燃料制御スイッチが相次いで「run（運転）」から「cutoff（遮断）」に切り替わった後、両エンジンが停止した。スイッチがなぜ切り替わったのか、誰が操作したのかは特定されなかった。

item.title: 「トゥキディデスのわな」とは？ なぜ習氏がトランプ氏に語るのか
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 中国の習近平国家主席は9月下旬、ワシントンでトランプ米大統領と会談した際、「トゥキディデスのわな」を回避するため、米中協力を一段と強化するよう呼びかけた。

学術的にも聞こえるこの言葉は、米中関係を巡る中国政府の構想の核心に関わる。習氏がこの言葉を持ち出したのは今回が初めてではない。トランプ氏が5月に北京を訪問したときにも、同じ考えに言及していた。

この言葉を2010年代前半に広めたのは、米ハーバード大学の政治学者グレアム・アリソン氏だ。古代ギリシャの歴史家トゥキディデスの記述を踏まえたもので、台頭しつつある大国がすでに覇権を握っている大国に挑戦すると、必然的に衝突が起き得るというのがアリソン氏の主張だ。同氏の研究では、歴史上このパターンが繰り返されてきたとされ、米中対立を考察する枠組みとして用いている。

簡単に言えば、構造的な緊張を巡る問題だ。経済とテクノロジー、軍事の各方面で中国が存在感を高め、世界の超大国として長年君臨してきた米国の優位が揺さぶられている。米中どちらも対立を望んでいなくても、競争そのものがコントロールしにくい圧力を生み出すリスクがある。

トゥキディデスは紀元前5世紀のギリシャの歴史家で、当時のペロポネソス戦争について、台頭する都市国家アテネと、すでに覇権を握っていたスパルタとの避けられない衝突だったと説明した。アリソン氏はこの記述を基に「トゥキディデスのわな」という言葉を生み出した。

北京を拠点とするアナリスト、王子辰氏によると、習氏がこの概念を使い始めたのは少なくとも2014年にさかのぼる。王氏は習氏が過去にこの枠組みに言及した事例を調査した。習氏は2024年11月、ペルーで開かれたアジア太平洋経済協力会議（APEC）首脳会議に合わせて当時のバイデン米大統領と会談した際にも、この言葉を使った。

item.title: メキシコ・ペソに売り、「キャリー取引の宴は終わった」－金利差縮小
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： メキシコ・ペソは過去1カ月のパフォーマンスが他のあらゆる主要通貨を下回った。これを受け、アナリストが年末予想を相次ぎ引き下げている。

ソシエテ・ジェネラル、モルガン・スタンレー、バンコ・バセはいずれもペソ予想を下方修正した。低金利通貨で資金を調達し、高金利通貨で運用するキャリー取引の投資家がこの市場から撤退している。

ペソは9月初めに2年ぶりの高値を付けたものの、月間で約6%下落し、ブルームバーグが追跡する全通貨で最も低調だった。かつて「スーパーペソ」と呼ばれたペソだが、米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）の利上げと、その後のメキシコ中銀の金利据え置きを受けて金利差が縮小し、売られた。この金利差が人気のキャリー取引を支えてきた。

ソシエテ・ジェネラルの新興国市場ストラテジスト、ブレンダン・マッケナ氏（ニューヨーク在勤）は「今回の売りが始まる前から、ペソは脆弱（ぜいじゃく）性を抱えていた」と指摘。「メキシコ中銀がFRBと足並みをそろえず、金利差の縮小を容認する姿勢を確認すると、ペソの脆弱性が表面化し、相場がそれを反映した」と述べた。

ブルームバーグがまとめたデータによると、米国とメキシコの金利差はこの1年だけで半減し、少なくとも2008年以来の低水準に縮小した。

メキシコ中銀が9月24日に政策金利を据え置いた後、ソシエテ・ジェネラルは年末のペソ予想を足元とほぼ同水準の1ドル＝18ペソに修正した。中銀の政策決定前は17.25ペソを見込んでいた。

モルガン・スタンレーは今週、10－12月（第4四半期）の予想を1ドル＝18.25ペソとし、従来予想より6%のペソ安水準に修正した。バンコ・バセも28日、10－12月期の予想をこれまでの17.80ペソから18.20ペソに修正した。

バンコ・バセの経済分析責任者、ガブリエラ・シラー氏は「キャリー取引の宴は終わった」と述べた。

ドイツ銀行のストラテジスト、カルロス・ムニョス・カルカモ氏は先週のリポートで、ペソについて「キャリー取引としての魅力が薄れている」と指摘。他の通貨と比べても割高感が強く、ポジションも「積み上がり過ぎているようだ」とした。ドイツ銀のストラテジストは年末予想を従来の1ドル＝17.5ペソから18.20ペソに修正した。

item.title: ニデック債、上乗せ金利さらに拡大－監査法人が有報に意見不表明
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： ニデックの社債スプレッド（国債との利回り差）が一段と拡大し、223ベーシスポイント（bp、1bp＝0.01%）となった。前期（2026年3月期）の有価証券報告書で監査法人が監査意見を表明しなかったことなどから、格付け引き下げや株式の上場廃止を巡る警戒が強まっている。

ブルームバーグのデータによると、2032年7月償還のニデック債のスプレッドは3月上旬以来の高水準で、直近3営業日で約39bp拡大した。

ニデックが30日に提出した前期の有報で、監査法人PwCジャパンは連結財務諸表に対する意見を表明しなかった。この期は6321億円の減損損失を計上し、純損益は5646億円の赤字となった。

フジワラキャピタルの土屋剛俊社長は、格下げや上場廃止のリスクが意識される中、機関投資家には不祥事を抱える銘柄を保有し続けることへの説明責任が生じるため、万が一に備えて売却する動きが出やすいと分析する。「不祥事はどういう風に転ぶか分からない」と述べ、予防的にリスクを落とす動きが出ているとの見方を示した。

また、三菱UFJ銀行と三井住友銀行との各3000億円のコミットメントライン契約で財務制限条項に抵触したことも明らかにした。両行は期限の利益喪失請求権を放棄しており、3月末時点の実行残高はゼロだった。

ブルームバーグは銀行借り入れの実行状況や、11月に期限を迎えるコミットメントラインの更新・再契約について同社に取材を試みたが、現時点でコメントは得られていない。

item.title: AI関連以外も米経済押し上げ－ミネアポリス連銀のカシュカリ総裁
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米ミネアポリス連銀のカシュカリ総裁は9月30日、AI関連の建設ブームを除けば米経済は縮小しているとの見方に懐疑的な見解を示した。

カシュカリ総裁はニューヨーク市内で開かれた外交問題評議会（CFR）のイベントで、「経済のその他の部分が縮小しているという見方には懐疑的だ」と指摘。「企業利益を見ると、AI関連の設備投資に直接関係する分野だけでなく、経済の多くのセクターで総じて非常に力強く増加している」と話した。

また、失業率が4.1%であることに加え、「全米で解雇が非常に少なく、失業保険申請件数も非常に少ない」と述べた。一方、住宅市場が圧迫されていることは認めた。

カシュカリ総裁は「経済の多くのセクターは堅調だと思う。ただ、AIが明らかに成長の真のけん引役だ」と語った。

米金融当局者は9月15、16両日の連邦公開市場委員会（FOMC）会合で、2023年以来となる利上げを全会一致で決めた。当局者の四半期経済予測の中央値によると、年内にあと1回の追加利上げ見通しも示された。

カシュカリ総裁は、自身の予測は中央値と一致していると述べる一方、新たなデータ次第で見通しが変わる可能性があると語った。

カシュカリ総裁は、インフレ率は依然として高過ぎるとし、連邦準備制度が小幅な調整によって物価上昇を抑制できることを期待していると述べた。

米金融当局者の間では、インフレが中東での紛争や関税の影響を受ける品目だけにとどまっていないとの懸念が強まっている。

カシュカリ総裁は「エネルギーは、われわれが購入するほぼ全てのものに関わっている」とし、「企業に聞いてみれば分かる。燃料価格の上昇に加え、人手の確保が難しくなっていることもあり、経済全体で輸送コストが上昇している」と説明した。

原題：Fed’s Kashkari Says AI Not Only Driver of US Economic Growth（抜粋）

item.title: 【日本市況】158円台に円下落､利上げ期待後退－日銀後手懸念し債券安
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 1日の日本市場では、円が対ドルで158円台に下落。米国で個人消費の好調が示されドルが堅調な中、日本銀行の金融政策決定会合の「主な意見」が連続利上げへの期待を強める内容とならず、円売りが進んだ。債券は下落（利回りは上昇）。株式は日経平均株価が続伸している。

日銀が公表した9月の決定会合の主な意見では、物価上振れの兆候が見えれば、利上げのペースを速めざるを得ないとの意見が政策委員から示された。一方、内閣府からの出席者は「既往の利上げが累積的に与える影響」について十分点検するよう求めた。同会合では、政策金利を31年ぶりの高水準となる1.25%に引き上げた。

あおぞら銀行の諸我晃チーフマーケットストラテジストは、主な意見について「10月の連続利上げを示唆するような材料は出ておらず、政府側からのコメントも今まで通りの印象だ」と語った。全体的に無難な内容で、発表前に警戒で買われていた円が売られているのではないかと分析した。

円は対ドルで下落し、一時158円22銭と9月25日以来の安値を付けた。

外為どっとコム総合研究所の神田卓也シニア為替アナリストは、日銀の主な意見が「連続利上げ期待を強めるほどタカ派ではなかったことが円売りにつながっている可能性がある」との見方を示した。同時に公表された日銀の企業短期経済観測調査（短観）については「大企業製造業の景況感は予想を若干下回ったが、前回から改善しておりおおむね予想通りの内容だった」と言う。

9月の短観では、大企業製造業の景況感がプラス24と6四半期連続で改善し、約8年半ぶりの高水準となった。市場予想のプラス25は下回った。

債券は堅調な米経済指標や財政懸念を背景に下落。日銀の連続利上げ期待が後退する一方、インフレ対応が後手に回るビハインド・ザ・カーブへの懸念も意識され、長期・超長期債を中心に売りが出ている。新発30年債利回りは6bp高い4.2%に上昇した。

item.title: 日銀9月会合、物価上振れ兆候なら利上げペース加速も－主な意見
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 日本銀行が利上げを決めた9月の金融政策決定会合で、物価上振れの兆候が見えれば、利上げのペースを速めざるを得ないとの意見が政策委員から示された。「主な意見」を1日に公表した。

同委員は、物価が今後も2%目標と整合的に推移し、金融環境が緩和的であれば、引き続き利上げによって緩和度合いを調整する必要があると主張した。

物価上振れを防ぐ意志を市場に示し、為替市場を通じた影響にも配慮する必要があるとの声もあった。一時的要因を除いた基調物価上昇率は2%にかなり近づいており、アンカーさせられるかを議論する必要があるとの意見も出た。

9月17、18日の会合では、政策金利を31年ぶりの高水準となる1.25%に引き上げた。前回の利上げから3カ月後で、植田和男総裁の下での最速ペースとなった。公表文に緩和調整を続ける方針を改めて明記。総裁は会見で、政策の「局面変化」に言及し、さらなる利上げに前向きな姿勢を示した。複数の委員が、引き続き緩和度合いを調整する必要性を主張した。

日銀の金融政策を巡っては、ベッセント米財務長官から利上げ継続に期待感を示す発言が相次いだ。市場は今後の利上げペースを見極める上で、9月会合における政策委員らの見解を注視していた。

足元の金利スワップ市場では、10月の利上げを約21%、12月までを完全に織り込んでいる。

9月会合では、財務省の出席者が「市場等には丁寧に政策趣旨を説明していただきたい」と発言、内閣府は「既往の利上げが累積的に与える影響について十分点検していただきたい」と述べた。

同会合では高市早苗政権の指名で審議委員に就任した浅田統一郎、佐藤綾野両氏が反対票を投じた。利上げに慎重な高市政権のスタンスが確認されたとの見方から、決定直後から円安が進んだ。

早期の追加利上げ観測が広がる中、政府側からの発言も注目されていた。

18日には城内実経済財政担当相が出席。25日の記者会見では日本経済の現状について、金融緩和と機動的な財政出動を行うリフレーション政策の局面ではないとの認識を示している。

item.title: 日銀短観､大企業製造業景況感は8年半ぶり高水準－年内利上げ観測支え
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 日本銀行が1日発表した9月の企業短期経済観測調査（短観）によると、大企業製造業の景況感は6四半期連続で改善した。約8年半ぶりの高水準となった。市場で高まる日銀による年内の追加利上げ観測を下支えする内容となった。

大企業製造業の景況感を示す業況判断指数（DI）はプラス24と前回6月調査のプラス22を上回り、2018年3月以来の水準。市場予想のプラス25は下回った。石油・石炭製品、鉄鋼などの改善が目立った。先行きはプラス21と悪化が見込まれている。

一方、大企業非製造業の業況判断DIはプラス35となり、5期ぶりに悪化した。市場予想のプラス36を下回った。宿泊・飲食サービスなどが悪化した。先行きもプラス30と悪化の見通し。

今回の短観は、世界的なAI関連需要の拡大や緊張状態が続く中東情勢が企業の景況感や事業計画などにどのような影響を与えているかが注目された。AI需要の恩恵が大きい大企業製造業を中心に良好な景況感が維持された形で、市場では日銀による次の利上げのタイミングとペースを探る展開が続きそうだ。

日銀は短観では企業の景況感とともに、インフレ期待を示す「企業の物価見通し」も重視している。企業が想定する消費者物価指数（CPI）の前年比上昇率は平均で1年後2.6%（6月調査2.7%）、3年後2.6%（同2.6%）、5年後2.5%（同2.6%）となった。

2026年度の大企業全産業の設備投資計画は前年比11.3%増。前回調査（11.5%増）から下方修正され、市場予想（12.2%増）も下回った。

大和総研の中村華奈子エコノミストは業況判断は製造業、非製造業ともに予想通りの動きだったと指摘した。物価見通しに関しても引き続き高い状態が続いているとし、「利上げの必要性が意識されるような内容だ」との見方を示した。

1日の日本市場では、円が対ドルで157円台後半に下落。米国で個人消費の好調が示されドルが堅調な中、日本銀行の金融政策決定会合の「主な意見」や企業短期経済観測調査（短観、9月調査）の公表後に円売りが進んだ。債券は下落（利回りは上昇）。株式は日経平均株価が続伸している。
